scoring_justification: Full recompute of DFPT phonon frequencies requires running Quantum ESPRESSO, which is not feasible in the verifier environment. The checker compares agent-reported frequencies against paper-derived hidden gold with tolerance and alkali-dependence consistency checks.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold Γ-point H_g phonon frequencies for K3C60, Rb3C60, Cs3C60
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Table II of Phys. Rev. B 88, 054510 (2013)
hidden_assets.generation_method: Midpoints of the reported frequency ranges for each H_g mode and compound.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Exact midpoints of the paper’s published ranges; traceable to the original data.

outputs.description: Γ-point H_g phonon frequencies for the three alkali-doped fullerides. Frequencies are compared against hidden reference values with tolerance.
